U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.zh: WHO於今年5/14召開第45次IHR小兒麻痺症緊急委員會並於8/25公布決議,今年截至4/30全球累積報告16例WPV1病例、2 例cVDPV1病例、28例cVDPV2病例及2例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分:累計報告74件WPV1、27件cVDPV2。考量全球疫情傳播及疫苗覆蓋率,評估持續構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並再延⻑臨時性措施3個月,惟不構成緊急大流行(Pandemic Emergency),並建議有11個國家(有WPV1、cVDPV1、cVDPV3傳播風險者)需加強疫情監測及疫苗接種等措施,包括有WPV1疫情之阿富汗、巴基斯坦、德國,有cVDPV1 疫情之阿爾及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國、吉布地、以色列、寮國,有cVDPV3疫情之喀麥隆、查德、奈及利亞;另建議24個有cVDPV2國內傳播風險的國家加強防治措施。由於核疫區的持續傳播、偏鄉與衝突地區疫苗接種覆蓋率不均以及頻繁的跨國人口流動,WPV1及cVDPV仍具有高度國際傳播風險 。 WHO於8/19宣布非洲5國cVDPV2疫情已終止,分別為蒲隆地 、迦納、幾內亞比索、剛果共和國及烏干達。當局近年透過資金與技術支援、加強疫苗接種,強化急性無力肢體麻痺監測與實驗室檢驗能力,以及應用地理資訊系統的成功阻斷疫情。
U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年6/30累計145國/地區報告18萬8,565例確定病例,其中521例死亡。 今年6月共計33國家/地區報告1,128例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:0.8%),以馬達加斯加(546例)、美國(111例)、剛果⺠主共和國(86例)、英國(46例)及葡萄牙(45例)為高,64%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年5月,美洲區及東南亞區病例數呈上升趨勢,其餘地區疫情則下降;東地中海區則無通報病例。哥斯大黎加、迦納及立陶宛通報首例Ib型病例;幾內亞比索首度通報3例IIb型病例。 非洲地區近6週(6/8-7/19)共計10國報告1,112例確定病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:1.1%),以馬達加斯加(940例)、安哥拉(57例)、肯亞(48例)、剛果⺠主共和國(30例)及喀麥隆(24例)為高。 非洲以外地區,共11國報告Ib型社區傳播;近6週報告Ib型病例最多國家為葡萄牙(60例),其次為英國(31例)、泰國(29例)、法國(18例)及西班牙(16例)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情,截至7/19,累計報告2,921例確定病例及18例死亡(CFR:0.6%)。疫情擴及全國61%行政區(70/115),主要影響15-49歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(89,723人施打第1劑),惟因檢測陽性率由65%上升至74%,以及面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流、醫療量能與風險溝通等挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。 安哥拉自今年5月中旬起疫情升溫,截至7/19累計108例確定病例及1例死亡(CFR 0.9%),主要集中於Cabinda省(佔80%),52%病例為20-29歲族群,其中女性及女童比例高達66%,當局已啟動相關防治措施。
nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.

jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 31 May this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 185,882 confirmed cases, including 509 deaths. In May this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.3%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (649), China (89), France (63), Australia (50) and Germany (45), and 63.9% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with April this year, case numbers rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions and declined in other regions. Norway reported its first clade Ib case, and Poland's earlier clade I case has been identified as a clade Ib sub-lineage. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (4 May–14 June), 10 countries reported 790 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.45%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar, Kenya, Guinea, South Sudan, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outside Africa, Spain and Thailand continued to report clade Ib community transmission. Madagascar has faced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 14 June this year, 2,117 confirmed cases and 7 deaths (mostly among immunocompromised people) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 60% of the country's administrative areas (69 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15 to 49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has been rolled out (more than 79,000 people vaccinated), the outbreak remains uncontrolled because of challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics and health system capacity.

kY4peGDHORIBotL0ZEMU2w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/1-5/7期間, cVDPV2型新增查德1例,cVDPV3新增幾內亞1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增阿富汗7件,cVDPV2陽性樣本新增3國共3件,分別為喀麥隆、中非共和國、吉布地各1件。
kY4peGDHORIBotL0ZEMU2w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 1 April and 7 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 1 in Chad, and cVDPV3 cases by 1 in Guinea. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 7 in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 3 across 3 countries: 1 each in Cameroon, the Central African Republic and Djibouti.

AdEEOhlIAriIvuJj5XJKmw.en: Africa epidemic update: As of 30 November 2024, 1,138 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 41 confirmed and 7 deaths. Cases were distributed as follows: Republic of the Congo (452), Central African Republic (390), Gabon (146), South Sudan (139), Cameroon (8), Guinea (2) and Uganda (1).

F5sIzm5Rr4eGoqfgVv6TEA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 12/12-12/18期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共2國新增7例cVDPV2,分別為查德4例、奈及利亞3例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增8件WPV1陽性樣本;共8國新增23件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為德國7件、英國5件、奈及利亞/南蘇丹各3 件、查德2件、喀麥隆/象牙海岸/芬蘭各1件。 澳洲墨爾本於汙水中檢出VDPV2陽性樣本,經檢測可能與海外接種小兒麻痺活性疫苗人員相關,並於維多利亞州境內持續散播,當局表示當地疫苗接種率高且汙水經有效處理,評估傳播風險為低。
F5sIzm5Rr4eGoqfgVv6TEA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 December, Pakistan reported four new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported seven new cVDPV2 cases: four in Chad and three in Nigeria. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported eight new WPV1-positive samples. Eight countries reported 23 new cVDPV2-positive samples: seven in Germany, five in the United Kingdom, three each in Nigeria and South Sudan, two in Chad, and one each in Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire and Finland. In Australia, VDPV2-positive samples were detected in wastewater in Melbourne. Testing suggests they may be linked to personnel who received live oral polio vaccine overseas, and the virus continues to spread within Victoria State. Authorities state that vaccination coverage in the area is high and wastewater is effectively treated, and they assess the transmission risk as low.

yfYSgiBBBmPA7Ey6MbHpyA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 10/24-10/30期間,巴基斯坦新增2例WPV1病例;查德新增2例cVDPV2病例;幾內亞新增3例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分,阿富汗新增1件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增4件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為喀麥隆/幾內亞/日/塞內加爾各1件。 西班牙於10/3報告該國首件cVDPV2陽性樣本,該樣本於9月中旬自該國東北部加泰隆亞廢水樣本中檢出,當地迄無報告病例,當地疫苗覆蓋率逾92%,評估對公眾健康影響有限。 法屬圭亞那於10/14首次檢出cVDPV3陽性樣本,樣本採集自首府開雲(Cayenne),目前尚無報告病例。
yfYSgiBBBmPA7Ey6MbHpyA.en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 24 and 30 October, Pakistan added 2 WPV1 cases, Chad added 2 cVDPV2 cases and Guinea added 3 cVDPV3 cases. For environmental samples, Afghanistan added 1 WPV1-positive sample; a total of 4 countries added 4 cVDPV2-positive samples, one each in Cameroon, Guinea, Niger and Senegal.

Spain reported on 3 October its first cVDPV2-positive sample, detected in mid-September in wastewater from Catalonia in northeastern Spain. No cases have been reported locally, local vaccination coverage exceeds 92%, and the impact on public health is assessed as limited.

French Guiana detected its first cVDPV3-positive sample on 14 October. The sample was collected in the capital, Cayenne. No cases have been reported so far.
